legend-manali-leh-highway.story: A high-altitude expedition road from Manali, Himachal Pradesh to Leh, Ladakh, via Keylong. Key character: Himalayan passes; barren plateaus; river valleys. Surface: mixed.

scenicChapters.title: Leh–Manali Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 68 km this is Leh–Manali Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
